source.sourceBasis: Candidate source files reconstructed from the retained tag patch against the archived stock tree. Class hashes identify the binary inputs.

protocol.statistics: Ratios of arm medians; ranges across fresh JVMs. No pooling.
protocol.scope: Both collections compare the source candidate with unchanged main at the same base revision. The numerical budgets apply relative to that parent.

manifest.hashAlgorithm: SHA-256; JARs hash raw bytes; class-directory hashes digest the ordered JSON array of [relative file name, raw file digest].
